label: Diagram 5
caption: Diagram 5 External steps and stairs – key dimensions
description: The drawing is a side section of an external flight of stairs rising from left to right, with a sloping rail above the steps. A note at the top reads "900mm to 1000mm above pitch line", indicating the height of the rail measured from the sloping pitch line. A vertical dimension arrow on the left is labelled "300mm min.". On the left, a vertical dimension reads "900mm to 1100mm". On the right, a horizontal dimension near the top of the flight reads "300mm min.", a vertical dimension reads "900mm to 1100mm", and a note at the right-hand end reads "12 risers max. (going less than 350mm) 18 risers max. (going 350mm or more)". The steps are drawn as a series of right-angled treads and risers, with the rail following their slope above them, and dashed projection lines link the dimension figures to the relevant points on the stair and rail.
